name: enterprise-hiring-training-platform
description: 企业招聘与内训一体化数字工作台

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"

scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview"
